# Founders' Den

> Founders' Den (by Morning Mic) is a private speaking practice platform for founders. Each member has their own login and a ladder of short modules built around one goal. They practise about ten minutes a morning, record each attempt, compare their first recording with their latest, and unlock the next module only after passing the current one.

## Who it is for
Busy founders and business owners who avoid public speaking, feel shy on camera or on stage, ramble when explaining their product, have a pitch or talk coming up, or speak English as a second language and want to sound clearer.

## Practice tracks
- Public speaking: the camera pitch, openings, client stories, Q&A and objections.
- Articulation: breath and pace (130 to 160 words a minute), clear consonants, stress, intonation, removing filler words.
- Subject-matter expertise: explaining your field briefly using point, reason, example, point.

## How to join
Founders' Den is open to a small founding cohort by application. Applicants are onboarded personally and pricing is confirmed on a call.
